activity.notes: Taharqa was a Kushite ruler of the Twenty-fifth Dynasty. This Activity records his sovereignty over the Kingdom of Kush; a separate Egypt Activity records his pharaonic rule there over the same reign window.

sources.title: Taharqo — British Museum
sources.citation_text: The British Museum identifies Taharqo/Taharqa as a Nubian ruler of Egypt, king of Upper and Lower Egypt, with life/reign dates 690–664 BCE.
